claims.text: A specific alloy composition and processing technique may improve the mechanical performance of lightweight high-entropy alloys.
A specific alloy composition and processing technique may improve the corrosion resistance of lightweight high-entropy alloys.
A specific alloy composition and processing technique may improve the high-temperature oxidation resistance of lightweight high-entropy alloys.
Optimizing alloy composition and processing may alter composition and microstructure in a way that improves mechanical properties.
Optimizing alloy composition and processing may alter composition and microstructure in a way that improves corrosion resistance.
The exact mechanisms responsible for the proposed improvements are unclear.
The available evidence is insufficient to support the proposed intervention.
Long-term performance data and intervention-specific evidence are limited.
Potential trade-offs may exist among the targeted properties.

contradictions.description: The intervention is described as a 'specific alloy composition and processing technique,' but no composition or processing parameters are actually specified, and the experiment states that these details still need to be defined.
